protocol_metadata.about: Origin Ether (OETH) is an Ethereum liquid staking token that allows users to deposit WETH (or ETH via the Zapper contract) into a yield-bearing vault and receive OETH that automatically accrues staking yield in their wallet without locking. The protocol earns yield by operating compounding Ethereum validators using EIP-4788 Merkle-proof-verified accounting, and deploys liquidity into Curve AMO strategies; the wrapped form wOETH is an ERC-4626 vault deployed on Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum. Contract upgrades are governed by OGN token holders through on-chain proposals subject to a 48-hour timelock, with a 5-of-8 admin multisig and a 2-of-9 strategist multisig retaining operational roles.
